articles.title: In 2014, NASA sent 800 ants to the International Space Station to study how they search without gravity; some spent seconds tumbling through the air
articles.description: Researchers sent ants to the International Space Station to investigate their behavior under microgravity. The experiment aimed to understand the dynamics of complex systems without the constraints of gravity, revealing valuable insights that could inform the future design of coordinated robotic systems.
